notes: SDK helpers transform unsupported constraints by moving them to descriptions. API returns 400 error for unsupported keywords.

rules.description: Objects must have additionalProperties set to false
rules.doc_quote: required and additionalProperties (must be set to false for objects)
rules.fix: Set "additionalProperties": false on all object schemas

rules.description: minimum is not supported (API rejects with 400 error)
rules.doc_quote: Not supported: Numerical constraints (such as minimum, maximum, multipleOf)
rules.enforcement: API rejects schema with 400 error; SDK helpers strip and move to description
rules.fix: Remove minimum constraint (SDK helpers can move it to description for client-side validation)

rules.description: Array minItems only supports values 0 and 1 (API rejects with 400 error)
rules.doc_quote: Array minItems (only values 0 and 1 supported) [...] Array constraints beyond minItems of 0 or 1
rules.enforcement: API rejects schema with 400 error if minItems > 1
rules.fix: Set minItems to 0 or 1, or remove it

rules.description: Recursive schemas are not supported (API rejects with 400 error)
rules.fix: Remove recursive references or flatten the schema
